thesis.core: The share-price trend is not supported by normalized current earnings. The legacy property business remained loss-making in 2026H1, while the new computing-power pivot requires a very large financed server purchase before sufficient contracted demand and project-level cash returns have been demonstrated.
thesis.variant_wedge: The AI-computing narrative can create optionality, but the disclosed economics are asymmetric: H1 attributable profit and operating cash flow were negative, while the September server purchase is at least RMB2.2931bn and the disclosed initial five-year service contract totals RMB633m. Financing, depreciation, utilization and customer expansion therefore dominate the equity outcome.
thesis.normalized_earnings_basis: Current earnings are negative, so use H1 parent common book value as a conservative valuation anchor and apply scenario PB multiples that explicitly limit credit for the unproven computing-power pivot.

operating_and_financial_quality.judgment: Legacy operations do not provide an earnings floor. Negative profit and negative operating cash flow materially reduce the balance-sheet capacity available to absorb execution errors in the new capital-intensive business.

financed_growth_gate.judgment: FAIL. The purchase commitment is much larger than currently disclosed contracted service revenue and is predominantly expected to be externally financed. The ratio is only an underwriting-gap indicator because capex and service-contract periods are not economically identical; additional customers could change the economics. Until contracted utilization, financing cost, depreciation and project cash return are demonstrated, a positive financed-growth conclusion is not supportable.

normalized_earnings_basis.rationale: Earnings and CFO are negative; book value is used as the conservative anchor while the new AI-computing business remains unproven.

catalysts: Additional creditworthy multi-year computing-service contracts materially increase contracted utilization beyond the initial RMB633m agreement.
Financing closes on terms that leave project-level ROIC and free cash flow clearly positive after interest, depreciation and maintenance capex.
Legacy property operations stop consuming cash and consolidated operating cash flow turns sustainably positive.
kill_thesis: Server utilization or customer expansion falls short, leaving material idle assets.
Financing cost, refinancing tenor or customer collection creates a cash-cycle mismatch.
Depreciation, impairment or operating costs cause the computing-power business to remain loss-making despite revenue growth.
Continued legacy losses or shareholder-funding dependence weakens liquidity further.
